contentList.content: Bind all your equipped weapons. They use your <LSTag Tooltip="Charisma">Charisma</LSTag> modifier, their damage becomes magical, you cannot drop or throw them, and you become <LSTag Tooltip="WeaponProficiency">Proficient</LSTag> with them if you weren't already.

Bind all your equipped weapons. They use your Charisma modifier, their damage becomes magical, you cannot drop or throw them, and you become Proficient with them if you weren't already.

When you attack with these weapons, there is a chance that Hexblade's Curse is applied to the target.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/> A weapon loses its bind when you unequip it, or when you stay away from it for more than 10 rounds.
